description: This file defines a PHP class 'sysinfo' for gathering system information specific to FreeBSD, including network stats, system ticks, and memory details.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class extending 'bsd_common' to collect FreeBSD system information such as CPU, network, and memory stats.
